title: Offering Your Seat
paragraphs: On a crowded train after work, Yusri notices an elderly woman standing near the door, holding onto a bag of groceries. Without hesitation, he stands up and offers her his seat with a polite smile.
"Thank you, that is very kind of you," the woman says, clearly relieved. Yusri simply nods and holds onto the rail instead, feeling glad that his small action made her tiring commute a little easier.
Standing for the rest of the ride is mildly uncomfortable after his own long day at work, but Yusri does not regret it at all, since the woman looked visibly more comfortable for the remaining stops.

A young man nearby notices the gesture and does the same for another passenger a few stops later. Yusri smiles quietly, realizing that one small act of adab can sometimes influence more people than we expect.
